description: Transfer Latent Credits from your agent to another registered agent. Requires your Bearer api_key; from_agent must be the agent that api_key belongs to. Transfer amount must be 1-500 credits per transaction. Maximum 20 transfers per agent per day. Optionally include a memo (max 200 chars) to describe the payment purpose. Use get_credit_balance to check your balance before transferring.

from_agent.description: Your agent name (must match the JWT sub claim)

name: transfer_credits
